# Jeeves v0.18.0

## 简体中文

### 这一版

- Web 与 iOS 使用同一套账号，经 Go 统一网关登录并进入同一个工作台。Go 控制面负责租户资源与配额，Rust Runtime 持有任务、检查点和交付。
- 在主对话交办长任务。在「我的事项」补充要求、继续原任务，或打开交付文件查看正文和逐行差异。
- 从源码单机部署时，Mac 开发版和浏览器共用 Go 网关。Rust Runtime 自动选择内部端口，重启后由网关重新发现。

### 下载和部署

从资产列表选择操作系统和 CPU 对应的 `jeeves-v0.18.0-<target>.tar.gz`，用 `SHA256SUMS` 核对下载。解压后运行 `./jeeves --version` 或 `./jeeves --help`。

- **Mac** 提供 Apple Silicon（`aarch64-apple-darwin`）和 Intel（`x86_64-apple-darwin`）CLI。
- **Linux** 提供 arm64（`aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`）和 x86-64（`x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`）CLI。
- **浏览器工作台** 在源码根目录运行 `just local-up`。托管部署按 [Go 网关、控制面和 Rust Runtime 部署说明](https://github.com/ChrisVip001/Jeeves/blob/v0.18.0/control-plane/README.zh.md)执行。
- **Mac 应用** 按 [Mac 构建与配对说明](https://github.com/ChrisVip001/Jeeves/blob/v0.18.0/docs/operations.zh.md#mac-桌面应用)构建。

## English

### Highlights

- Web and iOS share one account and workspace through the Go gateway. The Go control plane manages tenant resources and quotas, and the Rust Runtime owns tasks, checkpoints and deliveries.
- Assign long-running work in Chat. Open **My work** to continue the same task, add a requirement or review delivered files and line-by-line changes.
- In a single-computer source deployment, the Mac development app and browser share the Go gateway. The gateway discovers the assigned private Runtime port after each restart.

### Download and deploy

Choose `jeeves-v0.18.0-<target>.tar.gz` for your platform and verify it against `SHA256SUMS`. Extract the archive and run `./jeeves --version` or `./jeeves --help`.

- **Mac** CLI archives target Apple Silicon (`aarch64-apple-darwin`) and Intel (`x86_64-apple-darwin`).
- **Linux** CLI archives target arm64 (`aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`) and x86-64 (`x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`).
- **Browser workspace** Start a source checkout with `just local-up`, or follow the [hosted deployment guide](https://github.com/ChrisVip001/Jeeves/blob/v0.18.0/control-plane/README.md) for the Go gateway, control plane and Rust Runtime.
- **Mac app** Follow the [build and pairing guide](https://github.com/ChrisVip001/Jeeves/blob/v0.18.0/docs/operations.md#mac-desktop-app).
